properties.name: spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.ui.traffic.excluded-routes
properties.description: Moved out of the UI when the metrics became a plugin of their own, the exclusions being applied by every source and not just by the view.

deprecation.reason: The route metrics are no longer owned by the UI module.

values.description: Read the consolidated figures from Prometheus. The only source that survives an instance being replaced. Requires spring-cloud-gateway-metrics-prometheus.
Each instance publishes its figures into Redis and the view sums them. Requires spring-cloud-gateway-metrics-redis.
Poll every instance registered in the service registry. Requires spring-cloud-gateway-metrics-discovery.
